ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.host_roo: You host Ion, the willpower entity. Everything the Green Lantern ring does is yours, stronger, no ring needed, and its light refills on its own. Toggle this to wear Ion's form. Give it up with Release or by saying "I release you". Another player can draw it out of you by sneaking with a corps' lantern and staring at you for five seconds. After you lose it, no entity will choose you for an hour.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.entity_t: What Ion adds to the Green Lantern ring's light: its own nature and abilities.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.skill_pa: Nothing moves you: no knockback, no slowness, weakness, blindness or darkness.

ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.giant_fi: A giant fist of will punches whatever is in front of you into the air. Costs 100 willpower.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.unbreaka: Toggle: Resistance III while your power lasts. Costs 1 willpower a tick.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.will_unb: Ultimate: a nova of pure will hurts and hurls everything within 12 blocks, and a construct train smashes through what's ahead. Costs 600 willpower.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.light_tr: Ion is a source of Green Lantern light: it fills the rings of its color, forges new ones, and shapes more than any ring can.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.empower_: Look at a Green Lantern ring bearer within 24 blocks: +1000 charge to their ring for 400 of yours.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.living_l: Toggle: become a living Green Lantern lantern. Green Lantern rings within 8 blocks recharge (+100 a second), and a bearer who sneaks beside you recites their oath for a full charge (800 of yours, once every 30 seconds each). Costs 20 a second.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.forge_ri: Forge a new Green Lantern ring from Ion's light, for someone worthy, no lantern needed. Costs 3000; once every 5 minutes.
ability.final_lanterns.host_ion.hard_lig: Hold: a second construct wheel, shaped by Ion: Baseball Bat, Battle Axe, Longsword, Greatsword, Hammer, Katana, Scythe, Spear, Axe, Pickaxe, Shield, Giant Fist.
